anchor.statement: Corollary 7.8. Fix α , ρ ∈ R , and use the normalized representatives of (7.35). Suppose U is a real divergence-free wave field, including its curl remainders, such that U = W as 0 + E, U ∈ W 1/2 , E ∈ W ρ . Let Σ (R, Z, T) ∈ M α be a real two-vector independent of the angular and auxiliary variables. Apply Lemma 7.7 to the signed amplitudes L asΣ , obtaining the divergence-free increment V = L asΣ + R, where R ∈ W α − κs is its curl remainder. Then C(U + V) − C(U) = Σ + B(E, L asΣ ) + B(U, R) + C(V). (7.41) The three remainder terms satisfy B(E , L asΣ ) ∈ M ρ + α −1/2 , B(U, R) ∈ M α +1/2− κs , C(V) ∈ M 2 α −1 . (7.42) Taking the radial divergence of each remainder term decreases the ε exponent by at most a further κ s .

correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: signedTensorRemainder_exact states the remainder as symmetricCovariance(old − primary, tangent) + symmetricCovariance(old, curl) + bilinearCovariance(tangent + curl, tangent + curl), i.e. B(E, Las Σ) + B(U, R) + C(V); symmetricCovariance_mem (class α + β from classes α, β) and blockCovariance_mem (class 2α) give, after instantiation, the separate exponents ρ + α − 1/2, α + 1/2 − κs and 2α − 1 of (7.42), and the three covariance-change lemmas give the further loss κ for any tensor of a given class. This instantiation, the class inclusion V ∈ W^(α−1/2) and the leading term Σ from the separate cross-covariance identity are the reviewer's assembly; signedTensorRemainder_mem itself records only one common exponent γ ≤ min(δ + β, α + η, 2β).

NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.signedTensorRemainder primary old tangent curl =
  NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.symmetricCovariance (old - primary) tangent +
      NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.symmetricCovariance old curl +
    NavierStokes.CorrectionState.bilinearCovariance (tangent + curl) (tangent + curl)

∀ {D : Type} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup D] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ D] {s : NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.StripData D}
  {P : ℕ → D → ℝ} {α δ β η γ : ℝ} (primary old tangent curl : NavierStokes.CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock D) (N : ℕ),
  NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.SameCarrier old primary →
    NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.SameCarrier old tangent →
      NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.SameCarrier old curl →
        primary.BandLimited N →
          old.BandLimited N →
            tangent.BandLimited N →
              curl.BandLimited N →
                NavierStokes.CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock.WaveBounds s P α old →
                  NavierStokes.CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock.WaveBounds s P δ
                      (NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.subBlock old primary) →
                    NavierStokes.CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock.WaveBounds s P β tangent →
                      NavierStokes.CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock.WaveBounds s P η curl →
                        (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), (primary.velocity n i).coeff 0 = 0) →
                          (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), (old.velocity n i).coeff 0 = 0) →
                            (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), (tangent.velocity n i).coeff 0 = 0) →
                              (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin 3), (curl.velocity n i).coeff 0 = 0) →
                                β ≤ η →
                                  γ ≤ δ + β →
                                    γ ≤ α + η →
                                      γ ≤ 2 * β →
                                        (∀ (n : ℕ), old.angularFrequency n ≠ 0) →
                                          (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ s.domain, 0 ≤ P n x) →
                                            (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ s.domain, P n x ≤ 1) →
                                              NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.TensorClass s γ
                                                (NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.signedTensorRemainder primary.oscillation
                                                  old.oscillation tangent.oscillation curl.oscillation)
